## Overview

This project is a **ready-to-run guide** for building smarter AI assistants that **look up real documents** before they answer—instead of guessing from memory.

You get a complete **16-week plan**, grading checklist, and a script that generates the full syllabus as a Markdown file on your computer.

**GitHub:** [sophalchan/rag-capstone-graduation-project](https://github.com/sophalchan/rag-capstone-graduation-project)

## What is this, in simple terms?

Many chatbots give confident but **wrong** answers when questions need **fresh or specialized** information (laws, medical papers, company filings).

A better approach is **RAG** (Retrieval-Augmented Generation):

1. **Find** the right paragraphs in your documents  
2. **Show** those paragraphs to the AI  
3. **Answer** using that evidence—with citations when possible  

This capstone walks through **three levels** of that idea:

| Level | Plain English | What improves |
|-------|----------------|---------------|
| **Basic** | Search once, paste text, ask the AI | Simple baseline |
| **Advanced** | Rewrite the question, search keywords + meaning, re-rank best passages | More accurate answers |
| **Graph-style** | Connect facts in a knowledge map + search | Better for complex, multi-step questions |

## Background of the Study

Organizations in **law**, **healthcare**, and **finance** cannot rely on generic AI alone. Answers must be **traceable**, **up to date**, and **grounded in source documents**.

Educators and team leads need a structured way to teach **how to build** these systems—not only how to prompt a model. This project packages that structure: ingestion of PDFs and tables, hybrid search, optional knowledge graphs, and **measurable quality checks** (faithfulness, relevance, precision).

## Motivation of the Study

- **For learners:** turn a vague “chatbot project” into a step-by-step engineering roadmap  
- **For instructors:** provide milestones, rubrics, and domain options (legal, medical, financial)  
- **For builders:** align with tools used in industry (vector databases, rerankers, evaluation frameworks)  
- **For reviewers:** show progress with numbers, not only demos  

## What you get in the repository

| Item | What it does |
|------|----------------|
| `scripts/generate_syllabus.py` | One command to build the full syllabus file |
| `outputs/GRADUATION_PROJECT_SYLLABUS.md` | Complete specification (architecture, domains, 16 weeks, grading) |
| `src/capstone_syllabus.py` | Source that generates the document |

Topics inside the syllabus include: multimodal document ingestion, hybrid search, knowledge graphs, and evaluation with **Ragas** or **TruLens**.

## Try it locally (verified workflow)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/sophalchan/rag-capstone-graduation-project.git
cd rag-capstone-graduation-project
python3 scripts/generate_syllabus.py
```

You should see: `Wrote syllabus -> .../outputs/GRADUATION_PROJECT_SYLLABUS.md`

Open that file to read the full capstone plan.

## Who is this for?

- Final-year **AI Engineering** students (teams of 3–4)  
- Teachers designing a **graduation capstone**  
- Developers who want a **clear RAG roadmap** without starting from a blank page
